name: cortex-praefrontalis
description: Hands the latest 10,000 characters of the conversation back to Claude, verbatim, after compaction, /clear and a new session. No summaries, no LLM, no extra files.

hooks.command: for p in python3 python; do "$p" -c 'import sys; sys.exit(sys.version_info < (3, 8))' 2>/dev/null && exec "$p" "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/cortex_praefrontalis.py"; done; exit 0
